object.attr: as implemented: ISO 8601, which sorts as text and reads the same in each locale; 2026-02-30 and year 0000 are no dates (review Q47). Another form is a validation error (MELLON-CHECK-SRS). Confirm the range against 0.3.0.
object.description: A manifest's date element shall hold a date written as YYYY-MM-DD, naming a day of the Gregorian calendar from 0001-01-01 to 9999-12-31.
